title: VIP perk for repeat attendees
description: Reward repeat attendees with a VIP perk such as priority entry. Loyalty reward WhatsApp template for event organizers. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Name the perk and how to claim it. Reward programs are marketing, so keep the opt-out.

body.text: Thanks for coming back, {{first_name}}! As a repeat guest you've unlocked *priority entry* and a {{reward}} at your next event.
